description:
Every CallEmission in jobs/semantic.rs is constructed with `latent_executables: Vec::new()` (five construction sites; resolve_closure_call binds a `let latent_executables = Vec::new()` it never pushes to), and the merge/rebuild paths only concatenate empties. So:

- the `for executable in &call.latent_executables` loop at the publish block never runs -- `analyze_activation` publishes no `Executable` fact at all;
- `ActivationAnalysis::latent_executables` is always an empty Vec for every activation, and every consumer of it reads an empty list.

Found while assigning each of analyze_activation's outputs to a derivation for fz-kdt.13.2 (the assignment had to enumerate the publish block; `Executable` was assigned to the whole-body answer, which is correct and also unreachable).

Remove the field from `CallEmission`, the field from `ActivationAnalysis`, the publish loop, and the `Executable` arm of the analysis's output vocabulary -- or, if latent executables are meant to exist, restore the site that fills them and say what fills it. Verify against consumers of `ActivationAnalysis::latent_executables` first.
title: analyze_activation's latent_executables is provably always empty
